title: SBC Guardian Native Message Envelope
description: Envelope shared between the Android wrapper (GeckoView) and the FSU WebExtension background core. Messages with unknown protocolVersion, unknown type, or stale sessionNonce are rejected by both sides.

protocolVersion.description: Must be exactly 1. Unknown versions are rejected.

messageId.description: Unique id (uuid) for this message. Echoed back on responses via requestId.

requestId.description: Set to the messageId of the request this message answers; null for unsolicited messages.

sessionNonce.description: Random per-app-session value. Messages from a previous session nonce are rejected.

type.description: Message type. Unknown types are rejected.

payload.description: Type-specific payload. Always an object (may be empty).

ts.description: Creation timestamp used to reject malformed envelopes.
